title: hugelia diffusa
intro: Hugelia diffusa, commonly known as Hangee, is a plant species native to Korea and parts of Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. Hugelia diffusa contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
